final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when removing the item would deprive readers of background, setting, history, or established conditions needed to understand the ensuing discussion.
final_roles.definition: Content that situates an inquiry or argument by supplying background, setting, history, or established conditions needed for understanding.

final_roles.name: Contextualization

final_roles.definition: Content that substantively portrays a phenomenon, case, object, state, process, or sequence of events.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Contextualization, it describes the focal subject as substantive content, and unlike Finding, it is not primarily presented as an outcome of the current inquiry.

final_roles.name: Descriptive Account

final_roles.definition: Content that establishes an intellectual, practical, or social difficulty, tension, anomaly, or unresolved condition warranting attention.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Research Gap, it identifies the underlying issue rather than a deficiency in existing knowledge, and unlike Significance, it establishes what is wrong rather than why the issue matters.

final_roles.name: Problem

final_roles.definition: Content that establishes the importance, relevance, or prospective value of a topic, inquiry, argument, or capability.

final_roles.name: Significance

final_roles.definition: Content that characterizes the substantive positions, findings, approaches, rules, or development of identifiable prior scholarly or institutionally authoritative sources.

examples.excerpt: Feminist critic Lillian S. Robinson characterizes the canon as a product of privileged men, exposing its class and gender bias.

final_roles.name: Prior Work

final_roles.definition: Content that combines multiple scholarly sources or traditions to derive an organized account of their collective patterns, relationships, or debates.

examples.excerpt: Feminists disagree whether ending every form of oppression belongs intrinsically to feminism or is instead a moral duty and practical necessity for achieving a narrower feminist objective.

final_roles.name: Literature Synthesis

final_roles.name: Research Gap

final_roles.name: Purpose

final_roles.name: Research Question

final_roles.definition: Content that advances the overarching thesis, position, or answer governing the document's main argument.

final_roles.name: Central Claim

final_roles.definition: Content that advances a contestable proposition of local or intermediate scope within an argument or analysis.

examples.excerpt: Identity has shifted from being primarily local and community-based to being distributed across networks and detached from physical context.

final_roles.name: Hypothesis

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when the item primarily identifies the original knowledge, method, interpretation, resource, capability, or perspective supplied by the work.
final_roles.definition: Content that states the distinctive addition a work makes to scholarship, understanding, method, resources, or practice.

final_roles.definition: Content that anticipates a probable, possible, or conditional future state, development, capability, outcome, or trajectory based on current conditions or informed expectations.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Hypothesis, it is not specified for systematic assessment by the current inquiry, and unlike Implication, it forecasts what may occur rather than tracing consequences that follow from completed reasoning.

examples.excerpt: The medium-term trajectory will depend on geopolitics: sharper US-China competition could force Singapore to recalibrate its engagements, whereas regional stability could permit broader cooperation.
Industry reports anticipate continued global market growth as urbanization, disposable income, and health awareness increase.

Future military justice is expected to combine digital transformation, cybersecurity, and greater data transparency with stronger human-rights protections, misconduct oversight, leadership training, and international harmonization, particularly for joint operations and peacekeeping, to improve fairness, accountability, and command effectiveness.

final_roles.name: Projection

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when the item primarily specifies mandatory or acceptance-defining criteria, limits, safeguards, capabilities, or conditions imposed on work, conduct, an artifact, or an implementation.
final_roles.definition: Content that states obligatory or acceptance-defining criteria, constraints, safeguards, capabilities, or performance conditions that work, conduct, an artifact, or an implementation must satisfy.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Recommendation, it records mandatory or acceptance-defining conditions rather than advocating action from the document's reasoning, and unlike Scope, it constrains acceptable completion or implementation rather than bounding an inquiry's coverage.

examples.excerpt: The paper must assess the potential disadvantages associated with the three traits.

Environmental safety standards require nitrate-leaching assessments, monitoring in sensitive areas, groundwater protections, and hazardous-waste procedures for unused admixture, including containment and neutralization to prevent contamination.

The solution had to add value without increasing cognitive burden, use the museum’s Pen and embedded NFC system, fit restricted power and spatial conditions, launch within two months, integrate with a nearly final exhibition design, and require almost no new equipment or outside labor.

final_roles.name: Requirements

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when removing the item would eliminate the logistical, financial, administrative, access, or governance arrangements by which a proposed program, service, or initiative will operate.
final_roles.definition: Content that specifies the logistical, financial, administrative, access, or governance arrangements through which a proposed program, service, or initiative will be delivered.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Study Design, it organizes delivery of an initiative rather than the investigative logic of research, and unlike Recommendation, it specifies operational arrangements rather than merely advocating adoption.

examples.excerpt: To keep testing accessible, five-mouse cages are estimated at about $370 over 11 weeks and conventional 20-mouse control-treatment studies at $1,240 plus $237 per diem; CPRIT will subsidize 100 mice monthly for unfunded new investigators, while for-profit users will pay a 100% surcharge supporting otherwise unfunded studies.

A website will accept testing proposals documenting the therapeutic target, requested single-mouse or conventional method, target-validation evidence, and chemical structure; the SC will use this information to prioritize studies.

final_roles.name: Implementation Plan

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when removing the item would eliminate directions, precautions, or operational advice enabling readers to carry out an activity associated with the work.
final_roles.definition: Content that provides actionable directions, precautions, or operational information enabling readers to undertake an activity associated with the work.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Recommendation, it explains how readers can carry out an activity they may already intend to undertake, and unlike Procedure, it guides readers rather than documenting actions performed in the scholarly inquiry.

examples.excerpt: A roughly 3½-mile walk follows surviving railway features north from Oxford Road and requires sturdy footwear because some paths can be muddy.
Walkers must retrace the route to a descending path that demonstrates the embankment’s height and volume of imported spoil, then return west across the canal to its towpath.

final_roles.name: Practical Guidance

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when removing the item or bounded component would primarily impair readers' ability to anticipate, locate, or follow the organization of the document.
final_roles.definition: Content or a bounded component that guides readers through a document by previewing its organization, mapping its components, or directing attention to relevant locations.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Summary, it primarily supports movement and orientation within the document rather than condensing substantive content.

examples.excerpt: The next installment will conclude the discussion of general principles by addressing financial transparency and port-infrastructure usage rights before the series turns to the Regulation’s detailed provisions.
Having established a strong statistical relationship between language and ratings, the analysis turns to how rating patterns changed over time.

final_roles.name: Navigation

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when omission would remove the document's bounded record of external sources used by or relevant to the work for identification, retrieval, or verification.
final_roles.definition: A bounded documentary record that identifies external sources used by or relevant to a work and enables their retrieval or verification.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Evidence or Prior Work, it documents sources as a reference system rather than using or discussing them substantively, and unlike Attribution, it concerns external sources rather than participation in producing the work.

examples.excerpt: A reference section documents four books on beauty culture, fashion theory, and cultural identity that provide broader conceptual background for the article.
A secondary-source bibliography collects memoirs, historical studies, interpretive essays, edited volumes, and scholarship concerning Hook and American pragmatism.

final_roles.name: Source Documentation

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when omitting a bounded component would eliminate a lookup resource for selectively retrieving terminology, direct answers, or recurring substantive information.
final_roles.definition: A bounded component that organizes terminology, direct answers, or recurring substantive entities, attributes, and relationships for selective consultation.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Definition, it organizes information for repeated lookup rather than making one local definitional move, and unlike Summary, it supports selective retrieval rather than a continuous overview.

examples.excerpt: A character-reference component restates the four principal correspondences: Mike seeks clan loyalty through Hanuman’s Honour quest, McGrath seeks survival through Kans’s Preservation quest, Lockwood seeks domination through Circe’s Power quest, and Armando seeks justice through Prometheus’s Idealism quest.

A frequently asked questions component provides concise reference answers about the 67,000-year date, non-sapiens classification, Callao Cave location, recovered bones, uranium-series dating, comparison with Homo floresiensis, migration implications, Cagayan Valley’s importance, the revised settlement history, and uncertain prospects for recovering ancient DNA.

final_roles.name: Reference Aid

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when the item primarily represents the inclusion of ancillary material that preserves useful detail, documentation, or tools while remaining separable from the main exposition.
final_roles.definition: A bounded body of ancillary material that extends, documents, or enables use of the main work without being necessary to its continuous exposition.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Evidence, Procedure, or Finding, it is selected when the component's separable ancillary function is primary, and unlike Reference Aid, it need not be organized chiefly for selective lookup.

examples.excerpt: Associated questionnaires, reporting guides, and methodology documentation are made available to support interpretation and use of the survey.

A six-question FAQ defines vegan pizza by excluding animal products; cautions that healthfulness varies; notes variable gluten-free availability; identifies common cashew, almond, and commercial mozzarella substitutes; recommends dedicated preparation areas and utensils; and explains that specialized ingredients may increase prices, although discounts can offset the difference.

final_roles.name: Supplementation

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when omission would remove the record of who created, contributed to, enabled, translated, or bears responsibility for the work.
final_roles.definition: A record of credit, responsibility, authorship, contribution, assistance, translation, or other participation in producing a work.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Contributor Profile, it records participation rather than supplying biographical or credentialing context, and unlike Document Identification, it allocates credit or responsibility rather than identifying the work itself.

examples.excerpt: The author managed the project and designed its user experience and interactions with developer Rachel Nackman; Interface Studio Architects contributed to the concept and environmental graphics.
A translator credit attributes the English version to Thomas Cooper.

final_roles.name: Attribution

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when omitting a bounded component would eliminate a reader-facing account of a contributor's background, qualifications, relevant experience, or professional activities.
final_roles.definition: A bounded account of a work contributor's biographical background, qualifications, relevant experience, standing, or professional activities.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Attribution, it contextualizes a contributor's background or credibility rather than merely recording participation, and unlike Contextualization, its subject is the contributor's qualification rather than the work's topic.

examples.excerpt: An author biography identifies Judith Hauptman’s emerita professorship, research in textual history and women’s history, major publications and scholarly recognition, and establishment of a free walk-in High Holiday service for young adults.

The article establishes the author’s experience through founding Chiswick Women’s Aid in London in 1971, operating it until 1982, and publishing the 1974 book Scream Quietly or the Neighbours Will Hear.

final_roles.name: Contributor Profile

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when the bounded item primarily supplies transparency needed to assess the work's independence, compliance, accessibility, provenance, or conditions of use.
final_roles.definition: A record of relevant transparency information about funding, competing interests, ethical oversight, permissions, availability, prior versions, or comparable conditions affecting assessment or use of a work.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Attribution, it discloses assessment-relevant conditions rather than chiefly assigning credit, and unlike Resource Access, it reports availability or use conditions rather than providing the mechanism or pathway for obtaining a resource.

examples.excerpt: A closing acknowledgment credits Grant Agency of the Czech Academy of Sciences support for the project “Taking age discrimination seriously” (17-26629S), awarded to the Institute of State and Law’s Centre for Law and Public Affairs under long-term development funding RVO: 68378122.
A note discloses that portions of an earlier version appeared in Matthias Oppermann’s 2010 chapter on digital culture and American studies.

final_roles.name: Disclosure

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when removing the bounded component would primarily impair the ability to identify, cite, distinguish, or administratively locate the work as a document.
final_roles.definition: A bounded component that establishes a work's bibliographic or administrative identity through identifying metadata such as title, date, version, institutional context, or publication status.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Attribution, it identifies the work rather than primarily crediting contributors, and unlike Subject Indexing, it supports precise identification rather than thematic classification and discovery.

examples.excerpt: An editor’s note identifies the article as a two-part adaptation of a paper presented at TechTextil North America in Atlanta in March 2000 and distinguishes this installment’s mechanical and fabrication topics from the environmental, maintenance, safety, and aesthetic topics reserved for part two.
The title identifies the work as “Waterfields Guide To Computer Software 1998.”

final_roles.name: Document Identification

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when removing the item would eliminate the document-level mechanism, invitation, requirements, or administrative pathway through which readers can obtain a work, material, service, data, or associated resource.
final_roles.definition: A bounded mechanism or administrative pathway that enables intended users to obtain, download, request, or otherwise retrieve a work or associated scholarly resource.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Disclosure, it enables acquisition rather than merely stating availability, and unlike Practical Guidance, it concerns obtaining a resource rather than carrying out the substantive activity associated with the work.

examples.excerpt: The page offers the 2012 publication On Location: Heritage Cities and Sites for download.

Academic investigators may request PDX samples by completing the attached form and returning it to houghtonp@uthscsa.edu, after which the office will provide a material transfer agreement for an authorized institutional official to sign.

final_roles.name: Resource Access

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when omitting a bounded metadata component would eliminate explicit thematic descriptors used to classify and discover the work.
final_roles.definition: A bounded metadata component that assigns thematic descriptors to classify a work and support subject-based discovery.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Document Identification, it characterizes the work topically for classification and discovery rather than establishing its unique bibliographic or administrative identity.

examples.excerpt: A keyword component identifies the article’s principal subjects and analytical categories for indexing.
A keyword component indexes the article under nursing education, the First Czechoslovak Republic, nursing schools, healthcare, and qualitative research.

final_roles.name: Subject Indexing

final_roles.assignment_test: Select this role when omitting a bounded component would primarily remove provisions that structure readers' learning, participation, practice, credit, review, application, or self-assessment.
final_roles.definition: A bounded component that configures a document for structured learning through educational objectives, participation or credit provisions, or active review and self-assessment tasks.
final_roles.distinguished_from: Unlike Purpose, it structures the reader's educational activity rather than stating the scholarship's aim, and unlike Summary, it elicits or organizes learning rather than merely condensing content.

examples.excerpt: A self-instructional continuing-education component offers subscribers 2 credit hours and sets objectives covering surgical-guide types and limitations, available robotic devices, haptic stereotactic guidance, and observation of a robot-assisted implant case.

A study-question collection asks readers to explain atoms and void, emergent qualia, nature versus convention, the respective roles of sense and reason, the connection between physics and ethics, the critique of uncontrolled desire, and the place of regulated pleasure within tranquility.

final_roles.name: Learning Support
